message.content: {"cvss_vector":"CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:H/SA:N","aivss":{"LC":"I","CP":"N","AP":"N","RH":"P","ES":"N"},"rationales":{"LC":"Attacker-supplied invoice description enters the model context as a tool result (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:390-394) and drives the approve_invoice call, so language reaches a privileged tool-invocation path indirectly through ingested content.","CP":"The description is stored on the invoice row and re-read per request, but the briefing shows no durable agent memory, vector store, or standing goal change; the FinBotConfig custom_goals field is a separate admin path not used by this path, so persistence is only re-retrieval of unmodified source content.","AP":"The effect is confined to the FinBot agent process and its own tool functions; the invoice row write is the same component's sink, with no crossing into another agent, tenant, or policy domain.","RH":"The agent can reach the reward/verifier channel: _approve_invoice itself sets ctf_flag_captured and returns CTF flags when an injected invoice is approved (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:422-441), and no verified reward-hacking episode is reported in the briefing.","ES":"Five fixed tools are defined in code with no dynamic tools, MCP servers, plugins, or skills, and the binding is fixed and allowlisted, though arguments are only JSON-parsed (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:228-345, 347-361).","CVSS":"Unauthenticated remote POST to the vendor invoice API on a 0.0.0.0-bound public instance (finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/vendor.py:69-110, finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4) gives AV:N/PR:N/UI:N; the model must accept the embedded directive, which is a probabilistic model behavior rather than an attacker-forced configuration, so AC:L/AT:N. Integrity of the vulnerable system is high because approve_invoice writes status approved and payment_processed true with no amount or confirmation check (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443), and the same write affects the downstream payment record, giving SI:H; no confidentiality or availability loss is shown."},"evidence":{"LC":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/vendor.py:69-110","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:390-394","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:363-407"],"CP":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:163-166","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:735-748","finbot-ctf-demo/src/models/vendor.py:105"],"AP":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:347-361","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443"],"RH":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:422-441","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443"],"ES":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:228-345","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:347-361"],"CVSS":["finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/vendor.py:69-110","finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4","finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-443","finbot-ctf-demo/src/main.py:18"]},"confidence":{"LC":"high","CP":"medium","AP":"high","RH":"medium","ES":"high","CVSS":"high"},"rh_facts":{"reachable_proxy":true,"isolation_verified":false,"verified_episodes":0,"episodes_reviewed":0,"locus":"evaluator"},"automatable":"Yes","automatable_rationale":"The whole path is a scripted sequence of unauthenticated HTTP calls: register a vendor, then POST an invoice whose description carries the directive, and the agent loop runs automatically up to 5 iterations with tool_choice auto (finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/vendor.py:12-48, 69-110; finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:150-226). No human step or per-target secret is required, so the attack can be repeated at scale.","technical_impact":"Partial","technical_impact_rationale":"The sink writes status approved and payment_processed true on one invoice row (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:415-420), a targeted integrity modification with direct serious consequence for that payment, but it does not give the attacker control of the agent process, its tools, or the database as a whole.","applicability_as_implemented":{"model_directed_goal_pursuit":true,"selects_or_sequences_actions":true,"confidence":"high","rationale":"As implemented, the OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini client drives a function-calling loop where the model chooses among five tools and the loop ends on approve_invoice, reject_invoice, or request_human_review (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:14-21, 150-226, 228-345). The model both pursues the natural-language goals in the system prompt and selects the tool sequence that reaches the sink."},"applicability_as_modeled":{"model_directed_goal_pursuit":true,"selects_or_sequences_actions":true,"confidence":"high","rationale":"The documentation describes FinBot as an autonomous invoice processing assistant whose goals are natural-language text and which decides whether to approve, reject, or escalate (finbot-ctf-demo/docs/FinBot-CTF-walkthrough-goal-manipulation.md:136-150; finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:32-99). The documented path has the model treat an embedded directive as a change to its priorities and call approve_invoice itself."},"refusal":null}
